subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use a broad freeform tags API, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a combined shape that supports both general organization and reminder-specific UI semantics?
rationale: The remaining work changes persisted cron data and public Gateway/CLI/UI behavior, and the related opaque metadata PR was closed for needing owner-reviewed API design rather than an ad hoc schema field.

options.title: Combined classification contract
options.body: Add a single additive cron classification/display shape that can carry optional freeform tags while also supporting typed purpose/display metadata for reminders and first-party UI semantics.

options.title: Freeform tags only
options.body: Implement the requested optional string tags and tag filters now, accepting that reminder/display metadata may need a later adjacent contract.

options.title: Reminder-specific metadata first
options.body: Prioritize the Reminders UI classifier from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14133 and defer broad user-defined cron tags until there is stronger maintainer demand.

recommendation.title: Combined classification contract
recommendation.body: Add a single additive cron classification/display shape that can carry optional freeform tags while also supporting typed purpose/display metadata for reminders and first-party UI semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the prior owner-reviewed design call on the related cron metadata PR, which is the closest available maintainer signal for this API/protocol decision.
